svg.title: Jarvis v3 system architecture
svg.desc: ESP32-S3 satellite with on-device wake word and MultiNet fast path, Home Assistant on a Pi 4 as relay and orchestrator, and a CPU-only brain on the i5 with a two-decoder STT service, a hassil/retriever race, a three-gate guard chain, SQLite memory, and predict-only learning.
svg.text: Jarvis · system architecture after the 13 Sep 2026 review
Jarvis brain · i5 LXC · CPU only
hey_jarvis + VAD · always on · plays chime
absolute states only · shadow phase first
< 500 ms · needs HA, not the i5
starts with MultiNet · cancelled on a hit
Piper renders · FLAC · acks, errors, chime
cmd · p1 · p2 → HA → audit log
no barge-in · mic gated while playing
mic-mute GPIO · wall rockers if HA is down
STT + TTS by host:port on the i5
satellite → HA service · tier A only
VAD · one STT · one agent · one TTS
prefer-local OFF · else tier C bypass
by text · URL streamed to satellite
all on the i5 LXC, never on the Pi
exposed names → hassil slots + S2P grammar
B/C need both to agree · audio hash kept
text in → guard chain below → speech out
Decision — hassil ‖ retriever race, then the guard chain · nothing fires without passing all three gates
DistilBERT intent + slots · on a miss
score → P(correct) · fit from audit log
HA WebSocket · call_service · verify state · log the turn
ask, never guess · continue_conversation reopens the mic
Rejection at any gate drops to tier 2, whose output re-enters at gate 2.
HA's built-in agent and sentence triggers stay off: the brain is the only agent.
Memory — SQLite + sqlite-vec · one file, single truth
predict-only until N confirms · MultiNet too
Learning — built last · everything starts predict-only
Failure behaviour — silence is never an outcome
fast path still works, via HA
wake works · the action call fails
‘hey jarvis, undo’ · pair logged for review
13 Sep 2026 · voice/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md · v1 defect removed: dispatch on FAISS > 0.85 · embeddings retrieve, deterministic code decides
